writers.source: Saved-item rows selected by source key

writers.classification: After finding the saved-item handoff receipt/destination, verify locked source row set/count/digest, delete original root and mark receipt retired in one transaction. Replayed retirement is recognized. Retiring the recovery source is not retiring the item or its value.
writers.authority_boundary: Acknowledged destination plus matching retained source evidence precedes source removal; preserve original handoff across uncertain commit.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Locked source rows with matching digest and acknowledged handoff destination
writers.destination: Retired recovery source and receipt; item holdings remain at destination

writers.classification: Allocate a reward instance from its template, reserve summon state, and submit creation to the player. Template, reservation or submission failure discards the provisional object; an existing instance is reused. Successful submission alone is not durable creation or publication.
writers.authority_boundary: Retained grant entitlement and per-character summon reservation are distinct from committed item ownership. Preserve one creation identity through uncertain commit and compensate reservations without treating temporary cleanup as destruction.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Reward entitlement/reservation and provisional or reusable instance
writers.destination: Player creation submission or rejected candidate cleanup

writers.classification: After expired-grant SQL cleanup commits, remove matching live reward instances only after promoting contents; save affected owners. Duplicate-instance cleanup retains the first matching instance and preserves extras when promotion fails.
writers.authority_boundary: Grant markers alone do not prove duplicate durable UIDs. Preserve child ownership and distinguish revocation from duplicate projection cleanup; failed owner saves leave an unresolved persistence obligation.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Expired grant instances or extra duplicate live copies
writers.destination: Promoted contents and retired instances; failed promotion retains copies

writers.classification: Refuse dismissal of a nonempty reward container; otherwise extract the live instance and save the player. The grant entitlement remains available for a later summon subject to its cooldown.
writers.authority_boundary: Retire the active item instance without retiring the retained grant entitlement. Tie durable removal and save acknowledgment to the same ownership operation.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Extracted representation while grant entitlement remains

writers.classification: Recursively promote contents of account-bound reward containers in a player corpse before extracting the container. Mark the summon recoverable; SQL update failure is logged but extraction currently continues.
writers.authority_boundary: Death and reward provenance must own root retirement and child transfers. Recovery eligibility is not issuance; failed eligibility persistence cannot be silently equated with an acknowledged handoff.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Account-bound corpse reward container and its children
writers.destination: Promoted children, retired shell and recoverable summon marker

writers.classification: Submit a provisional crafted object to the player creation coordinator; refusal extracts the unadmitted output. Submission success alone does not prove durable output publication.
writers.authority_boundary: The enclosing craft or forge operation must retain input identities and output identity through commit, publication and save; provisional cleanup is not destruction of an admitted item.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Player creation queue or rejected candidate cleanup

writers.classification: Allocate low/high material prototypes to describe recipe requirements, then dispose them. The recipe description is changed, but the prototypes are never awarded.
writers.authority_boundary: Prototype probes must not mint value or append destruction. Any authoritative recipe payload update belongs to its enclosing operation.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Recipe description and discarded probes

writers.classification: Validate saved recipe availability using temporary target prototypes, including legacy recipe import. Dispose target probes without player publication.
writers.authority_boundary: Recipe entitlement import is distinct from ownership of a physical target; these probes do not create player holdings.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Saved/legacy recipe and temporary target template
writers.destination: Validated recipe availability and discarded probe

writers.classification: List/stat/info commands allocate and dispose item/material probes. Make also allocates material-name probes and disposes them on rejection or completion. These probes are not ingredients taken from inventory.
writers.authority_boundary: Separate temporary material probes from owned ingredients and provisional output. Probe cleanup cannot be counted as an economic input sink.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Preview or material-name output and cleanup; not inventory consumption

writers.classification: List, info and stat branches inspect temporary output/material prototypes and dispose them. The output allocated at the shared command entry is classified separately because make can admit it.
writers.authority_boundary: Display-only objects have no new player ownership. Shared allocation must inherit the selected command disposition.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: List/info/stat output and cleanup

writers.classification: Submit provisional tradeskill output through item creation; refusal disposes the unadmitted candidate.
writers.authority_boundary: Caller must retain transformation inputs and original outcome until durable output publication. Submission success does not prove save acknowledgment.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Player creation queue or rejected candidate cleanup

writers.classification: Source contains parchment consumption after an unconditional return FALSE. This path is unreachable in the current function and is not claimed active gameplay.
writers.authority_boundary: Preserve dormant source classification; reactivation requires linking recipe entitlement and physical scroll consumption.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: No active consumption under current control flow

writers.classification: Allocate a generic object and roll/configure forged payload before returning it to the caller; allocation does not publish ownership.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain exact rolled payload with the enclosing smith or forge inputs/costs; retries must not reroll.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Generic object allocation and forge rolls
writers.destination: Configured provisional object returned to caller

writers.classification: Consume the selected bandage after copying healing capacity, then schedule a healing event. Consumption precedes eventual healing outcome.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain consumed item identity and distinguish intended interrupted healing from technical persistence failure; healing capacity is not currency.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Consumed bandage and scheduled healing event

writers.classification: Allocate a target prototype for validation. Record recipe entitlement before consuming the physical scroll; duplicate/error paths dispose the probe and retain the scroll. Final target cleanup is not destruction of a player target item.
writers.authority_boundary: Link durable entitlement grant and actual scroll retirement; temporary target probes are not issued items. Failed or uncertain entitlement writes need original-operation reconciliation.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Physical recipe scroll and validation probe
writers.destination: Recorded recipe entitlement then scroll consumption; probe discarded

writers.classification: After successful output submission, allocate an old-material prototype solely for messages and dispose it.
writers.authority_boundary: Message-only prototype must not append another input consumption or issuance.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Message output and temporary cleanup

writers.classification: Credit player before finding/debiting keeper and writing keeper state. Missing keeper or failed debit is logged; refund is separate from the failed output grant.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain original payment/refund identity and both holdings. Partial reversal or uncertain persistence must reconcile without repeating player credit.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Player refund then attempted keeper debit/save; non-atomic failure remains visible

writers.classification: Discard a matching nowhere produced candidate only when the callback has no durable-commit evidence. A committed trade with failed live publication emits an alert and preserves the obligation.
writers.authority_boundary: Do not reverse or re-issue a committed trade merely because its live projection is missing; only unadmitted allocation cleanup is disposable.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; candidate checks source routing/publication structure, not native callback execution
writers.source: Detached produced candidate without durable commit evidence
writers.destination: Temporary candidate cleanup; committed publication obligation retained

writers.classification: Extract invalid stock after the discard transaction reports committed matching ownership.
writers.authority_boundary: Committed storage retirement owns the economic effect; live extraction must not append a second destruction.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; candidate checks source routing/publication structure, not native callback execution
writers.destination: Live stock representation extracted

writers.classification: After matched committed buy, credit keeper live cash and publish produced output or move existing stock to player and optional container.
writers.authority_boundary: Distinguish native projection from a new debit/credit or issuance; retain commit-to-publication obligations and target container identity.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; candidate checks source routing/publication structure, not native callback execution
writers.destination: Live keeper credit and buyer/container item placement

writers.classification: After matched committed sale, debit keeper live cash, unlink player item and either destroy the sold root or place it into keeper stock.
writers.authority_boundary: Committed sale owns value and custody changes; callback projection/cleanup cannot create a second payment or retirement.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; candidate checks source routing/publication structure, not native callback execution
writers.source: Committed sale and live player item
writers.destination: Live keeper debit and stored or destroyed item

writers.classification: On keeper death, unlink inventory; artifacts go to a valid room and other stock is extracted. With no valid room artifacts are also extracted.
writers.authority_boundary: Death disposition must distinguish surviving transferred UIDs from destroyed stock, retaining keeper/shop lifetime and child disposition.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Artifacts moved to valid room; other stock and artifacts without valid room extracted

writers.classification: Within the same room, subtract payer wallet cash and add it to recipient. Called for purchases and repair; item or service outcome occurs separately.
writers.authority_boundary: Link both holdings to the enclosing purchase/service and retain original debit-credit intent; do not classify recipient credit as unrelated issuance.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Recipient wallet in same room, before separate item/service outcome

writers.classification: Source contains unequip/unlink, merchandise transfer and cash change, but merchandise is forcibly set to null before the branch. It is dormant in current execution.
writers.authority_boundary: Reactivation requires linked item consideration and change; dormant sites are not runtime coverage.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Dormant merchandise/cash branch; merchandise forced null
writers.destination: Unreachable barter transfer/change under current control flow

writers.classification: Charge a configured inspection fee through transact before identifying shop stock; trusted players bypass the fee. No item custody change occurs.
writers.authority_boundary: Link payer and keeper cash to the inspection service; this fee is separate from purchase and stock cleanup.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Keeper payment without item custody movement

writers.classification: Submit a bank-payment command with a generic rejection callback; return zero on accepted submission rather than durable debit.
writers.authority_boundary: Enclosing service must retain bank holding, cost and outcome until commit/publication acknowledgment; callback logging alone cannot recover delivered goods.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
evidence: Source contract checks SUB_BALANCE uses typed payment submission; no service completion journey.
writers.destination: Queued command and rejection callback; acceptance not durable debit

writers.classification: Publish one denomination to every matching online account/racewar character. These are live copies of one shared bank holding, not independent player balances. This helper carries no revision fence.
writers.authority_boundary: Only an authoritative bank result may drive publication; do not append a new credit per online character. Single-denomination publication needs caller ordering/lifetime evidence.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
evidence: Source contract checks online account/racewar filtering; not native publication execution.
writers.destination: Matching online account/racewar live copies, without revision fence

writers.classification: Publish a complete shared bank snapshot to matching account/racewar characters, skipping older explicit revisions. UINT64_MAX bypasses revision comparison and revision update for the compatibility wrapper.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain shared holding lifetime and committed snapshot authority. Revisioned projection is not a new economic event; compatibility calls need an explicit stale-result policy.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
evidence: Source contract checks vector publication assignments and online account/racewar filtering; does not execute revision rejection.
writers.source: Shared bank vector and explicit revision or compatibility sentinel
writers.destination: Matching online account/racewar copies; older explicit revisions suppressed

writers.classification: Rebuild committed grant roots from retained payload/results. Temporarily displace conflicting live UIDs, restore them on failed materialization, or extract displaced copies and publish reconstructed roots on success.
writers.authority_boundary: Retained committed payload owns identity. Temporary graph cleanup and superseded live-copy removal must not retire durable items or mint replacements.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; candidate is source-structure reconciliation validation
writers.source: Retained committed payload/results and possible conflicting live UIDs
writers.destination: Reconstructed live grant roots; conflict copies restored on failure or discarded on success

writers.classification: Dispose unadmitted nowhere objects on queue/preparation failure or cancellation. Before-entry cancellation retains active journaled roots and removes only the unsubmitted tail.
writers.authority_boundary: Classify each request by durable status before disposal; retain active original-operation completion and do not treat temporary cleanup as an economic sink.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Freed provisional copies; active journaled roots retained

writers.classification: Queue player/room/before-entry creation requests and start single or batch movement. Existing runtime ownership selects operator_repair for a single grant; absent ownership selects creation. Admission failure leaves caller-owned roots, while accepted queues retain work.
writers.authority_boundary: Do not infer fresh value from the grant API name. Preserve existing owner identity, batch membership, output provenance and original operation through deferred admission and publication.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; candidate is source-structure reconciliation validation
writers.source: Caller-owned creation roots and request context
writers.destination: Accepted retained grant queue or unchanged caller roots on admission failure

writers.classification: Move root objects from character inventory into the corpse after committed batch handling; child relationships remain attached to their roots.
writers.authority_boundary: This is live projection of a committed corpse transfer, not new creation of the roots. Retain corpse lifetime and the original batch ownership evidence.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Character inventory roots after committed batch
writers.destination: Corpse contents retaining each root child topology

writers.classification: On leaving, move corpse roots out of the locker to its exit room, preserving their contents.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain corpse lifetime and destination custody; room relocation is not corpse creation or restoration issuance.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Exit-room corpses retaining their contents

writers.classification: Materialize zero-cost, weightless, non-wearable sorting/private-chest containers and publish them into the locker room. Private chest metadata and saved contents have separate retained sources.
writers.authority_boundary: Define explicit nontransferable representation policy for synthetic shells rather than minting new economic containers on each load. Preserve authoritative locker/chest identities for their contents.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Synthetic chest templates plus retained chest metadata/content
writers.destination: Weightless locker-room display shells with separately restored holdings

writers.classification: Promote contents into the chest room or limbo, then unlink and extract the synthetic chest shell.
writers.authority_boundary: Retire only the representation shell; child holdings survive and retain identity. Limbo fallback needs explicit custody disposition rather than silent loss.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Contents promoted to room/limbo; shell retired

writers.classification: After private-chest saves succeed, stage public contents and loose noncorpse items on a locker character. Reverse staging sorts items into chests or onto the floor, including money piles that bypass chest sorting.
writers.authority_boundary: Stable locker custody spans temporary character, room and sorting-container representations. Snapshot staging is not ownership issuance; failed private saves abort before public moves.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Locker public/loose contents after private saves
writers.destination: Temporary locker-character save staging, then restored sorted room/chest placement

writers.classification: Load a temporary character to check racewar access, then unequip/unlink and extract its loaded item copies before freeing the character.
writers.authority_boundary: Temporary access-check hydration and disposal must not admit or retire the durable player items.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Temporary access-check character and loaded item copies
writers.destination: Discarded probe representations, without durable holdings retirement

writers.classification: Extract objects left in a selected room before assigning it to a new locker session.
writers.authority_boundary: Prove previous session persistence and disposition before treating leftovers as disposable copies; recycled room numbers are not durable locker identities.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Objects in room selected for new session
writers.destination: Extracted live objects before session reassignment

writers.classification: Refuse artifact storage by moving artifact roots from the room back to the character inventory.
writers.authority_boundary: Preserve the same item UID and actual source/destination owner; refusal compensation is not a new grant.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Same player inventory, refusing storage

writers.classification: Charge an item-count-based entry fee from wallet or bank after entering the room. Bank submission refusal ejects the player; wallet submission result is not checked.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain service access and original payment identity through asynchronous outcome. Accepted submission is not paid admission; do not repeat charges on recovery.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Item-count entry expense; wallet result not checked

writers.classification: Create durable private-chest metadata first, then submit wallet or bank payment. Bank submission refusal attempts chest deletion; wallet return is ignored and success is announced.
writers.authority_boundary: Link chest entitlement creation, payment and compensation using original identity. Failed debit or deletion and uncertain commit must not leave an untracked free chest or double charge.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Player payment and newly created durable chest metadata
writers.destination: Private chest entitlement plus attempted expense; rollback limits retained

writers.classification: Allocate entrance features and difficulty signs, and place a generated quest sigil in the terminal room. Decorative features and transferable sigils require distinct admission policy despite shared generation.
writers.authority_boundary: Bind generated instance identity to the actual zone lifetime, not recycled room/VNUM; explicitly classify nontransferable features and retain transferable sigil identity.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Placed decorative features and transferable terminal sigil

writers.classification: Create a chest and key, configure contained object payload and random theme loot, move the chest from room to guardian inventory, and optionally grant an epic stone to the guardian. Moving the populated chest is not another issuance.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain rolled payload, nested item UIDs and zone-generation identity. Review value-array assignments, including object template 3 value[3], against data semantics; document transient NPC custody rather than inventing durable mobile authority.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Populated chest moved to guardian plus optional epic stone

writers.classification: Potion allocation and chest insertion are behind an explicit false condition. These are dormant source candidates, not active generated loot.
writers.authority_boundary: Reactivation requires retained random outcome and admission provenance; dormant mapping does not claim runtime coverage.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Potion branch guarded by false condition
writers.destination: No active loot creation

writers.classification: On initial eligible relic activation, update relic state/timer and randomly allocate and give a level potion to its carrier.
writers.authority_boundary: Tie one-time relic activation and exact rolled reward identity together; retries or reload must not reroll or award again after committed activation.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Eligible initial relic activation and potion roll
writers.destination: Updated relic timer/state and carrier potion

writers.classification: Consume a matching carried sigil, award epics to eligible participants, and create stones, materials and random equipment for the player. Repeated random reward iterations are distinct children of one turn-in.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain consumed sigil, recipient set, rolled payloads and child identities as one economic operation. Do not equate technical partial delivery with an intended smaller reward.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Matching carried sigil and participant entitlement
writers.destination: Consumed sigil plus epic/item rewards grouped under turn-in

writers.classification: Allocate and label a takeable no-rent sigil using a random zone description and the generated-zone index; caller publishes it.
writers.authority_boundary: No-rent does not mean outside transferable supply. Preserve generated instance identity and payload at first admission rather than treating the reused index as durable identity.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Provisional labeled sigil for caller publication

writers.classification: Reset destroys eligible takeable nonartifact objects and empty corpses, preserves walls, and moves surviving corpse/artifact roots to the entrance when it exists. NPC teardown occurs separately.
writers.authority_boundary: Record actual recursive retirement versus surviving custody transfer, including missing-entrance disposition; reset is not a blanket sink for all room contents.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Labyrinth live objects and NPC holdings
writers.destination: Eligible retirement and surviving corpse/artifact relocation to entrance

writers.classification: Load a relic prototype to inspect artifact tracking, then dispose it whether generation is accepted or refused.
writers.authority_boundary: Probe allocation and cleanup do not admit or destroy an authoritative relic; existing tracked state must remain unchanged.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Artifact-tracking inspection and cleanup

writers.classification: Allocate a relic candidate for an end guardian; discard it when already tracked, otherwise set its timer and publish to the mobile.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain artifact admission decision, original item identity and payload under zone-generation authority. Provisional refusal cleanup is not destruction of the tracked relic.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: End-guardian relic candidate and registry check
writers.destination: Timed NPC-held relic or rejected candidate cleanup

writers.classification: Select and allocate replacement equipment, submit cash cost, publish output, then extract original equipment and physical material unless using pouch material.
writers.authority_boundary: Link original input UID, actual material or generated-material source, payment and exact rolled output. Submission success is not payment commit; technical delivery failure must not masquerade as intended transformation loss.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Original equipment, cash and physical/pouch material
writers.destination: Replacement output followed by old equipment/material retirement

writers.classification: Allocate/dispose templates for base modifiers, material names, superior-plan requirements and modified-item descriptions. These are probes, not player-owned enhancement inputs.
writers.authority_boundary: Keep template inspection separate from owned-item mutation; do not append issuance or consumption for each temporary object.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Modifier/description/requirement data and probe cleanup

writers.classification: Submit cost, consume physical materials via vnum_from_inv or record pouch-generated usage, then increment selected modifiers and mark the existing item superior.
writers.authority_boundary: One operation must retain existing UID, before/after payload, actual input identities and cost. Availability checks do not make asynchronous debit and item mutation atomic. The indirect consumption helper needs semantic census coverage.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Existing equipment, cash and physical/pouch materials
writers.destination: Superior modifiers on same item and consumed cost/materials

writers.classification: Mutate existing item affects and enhanced flag, submit cost, and extract the physical enhancement material; description probes are separate.
writers.authority_boundary: Preserve original item identity and exact payload delta, linking material retirement and payment. Do not classify in-place improvement as new equipment issuance.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Existing item, cash and enhancement material
writers.destination: Changed affects/flag and consumed material; payment separate

writers.classification: Create an item on a newly materialized seasonal mobile before room placement.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain event-specific admission and actual item identity; transient mobile placement alone is not a durable owner identity.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: New seasonal mobile and item template
writers.destination: Item carried by mobile before room admission

writers.classification: After eligible NPC-death selection, allocate at most one chosen essence and place it on the dying NPC, with killer/pet-master attribution used for reporting.
writers.authority_boundary: Tie rolled reward to original death and subsequent corpse/item disposition. Reporting the killer is not proof the killer already owns the item.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: At most one essence on dying NPC

writers.classification: Allocate templates across the configured range, filter unsupported candidates, copy index metadata and discard each temporary object including failures.
writers.authority_boundary: Index construction is inspection, not economy issuance or retirement. Existing artifact/UID authority must not be inferred from these probes.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Copied enhancement index metadata and discarded probes

writers.classification: When configured and a NPC item reset is skipped, derive a high-quality material from the missing item and publish a newly allocated material to the mobile.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain the reset decision and replacement outcome; do not admit both skipped equipment and fallback material on retry. Preserve documented transient NPC custody.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Skipped NPC item reset and derived material choice
writers.destination: New high-quality material on mobile

writers.classification: Count matching carried objects, then unlink and extract the requested number; artifact extraction is logged. Caller selects by template, but consumption acts on concrete instances.
writers.authority_boundary: Capture exact consumed UIDs, nested disposition and original cause before retirement. A template/count is not durable item identity; helper success is not a persisted economic receipt.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Concrete carried instances selected by prototype/count
writers.destination: Unlinked/extracted instances and artifact log where applicable

writers.classification: Allocate an orb, consume the configured soul-shard count and publish the orb.
writers.authority_boundary: Link exact input UIDs and output admission, preserving the exchange outcome across allocation/payment/publication failure.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Configured soul-shard instances and allocated orb
writers.destination: Consumed shards and published orb

writers.classification: For a sufficiently high-level conjured pet, consume one greater orb before final pet setup/publication; trusted callers bypass it.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain consumed orb identity and original summon outcome; technical failure cannot silently duplicate or lose the input.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Greater orb for eligible high-level pet conjure
writers.destination: Consumed orb before pet setup, except trusted bypass

writers.classification: Consume faerie dust when refreshing eligible detection affects or adding detection to an existing sight effect.
writers.authority_boundary: Each actual dust instance must be consumed once for the retained spell outcome, including multiple eligible refresh branches.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Consumed dust and refreshed/added detection effects

writers.classification: Three ingredient-consumption calls occur after the unconditional disabled-command return. They are dormant source, not active item retirement; reactivation must link exact inputs to the character transformation.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain original enclosing operation and actual consumed UIDs; preserve dormant versus executable status and do not infer durable consumption from a helper call alone.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: No reachable retirement under current disabled command

writers.classification: Consume a set of scientific tools while adjusting salvage recipe chance/protection. Retain exact tool identity and the original salvage outcome; protection and chance changes do not create a second consumable grant.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain original enclosing operation and actual consumed UIDs; preserve dormant versus executable status and do not infer durable consumption from a helper call alone.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Consumed tool and salvage chance/protection adjustment

writers.classification: Submit a provisional salvage output through item creation; refusal extracts the unadmitted candidate and returns false.
writers.authority_boundary: Caller must retain original salvage operation and output identity. Queue acceptance is not durable publication, and technical refusal is not intended salvage breakage.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Player creation queue or rejected output cleanup

writers.classification: Allocate and submit two lower-quality materials, then unlink/extract the higher-quality input. The two grant return values do not gate input destruction.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain one input and both exact output identities as a compound transformation; partial technical delivery must remain recoverable under original identity.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Two separately submitted lower-quality outputs then consumed input

writers.classification: Failed skill or poor-quality random outcome destroys the input without usable output, subject to scientific-tool protection policy.
writers.authority_boundary: Persist the original intended gameplay outcome and consumed UID; retries must neither reroll breakage nor treat storage failure as this gameplay loss.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Salvage input subject to tool protection
writers.destination: Destroyed input without usable output on intended failure

writers.classification: Generate optional luck essence and guaranteed magical-item essence, one or two materials with rolled sale costs, and an eligible recipe scroll with target payload; finally extract the original item. Output submissions are separate and can fail independently.
writers.authority_boundary: Group input retirement, tools and every retained rolled output under one salvage identity. Item cost is payload, not wallet issuance. Recipe payload must retain target identity; partial success is not a complete salvage operation.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Original item and rolled salvage outcome
writers.destination: Separate material/essence/scroll grants then original retirement

writers.classification: Materialize and place doors, boards, heartstone, window, fountain, bank counter, town portal and library tome from hall configuration. Payload links hall identity or destinations; placement differs by racewar.
writers.authority_boundary: Define explicit nontransferable representation policy backed by object data; do not mint economic fixtures on every init. Any transferable object needs first-admission identity independent of recycled room/VNUM.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Placed hall-linked room fixtures; load/construction boundary must remain explicit

writers.classification: After loading each configured golem, zero all denominations before room placement and set guild/racewar metadata.
writers.authority_boundary: Template cash is provisional until the documented admission boundary. Zeroing before publication is not retirement of already-admitted wallet value; do not invent durable mobile identity from pointer/runtime slot.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Zeroed pre-placement wallet with guild/racewar metadata

writers.classification: Older room teardown unlinks fixture objects and clears member pointers without extracting those objects; entrance teardown separately extracts golems. Workshop matching-prop extraction is a different existing route.
writers.authority_boundary: Unlinking is neither proof of durable retirement nor proof the object was freed. Retain hall lifetime and explicit representation disposition; inspect children/transferable state before claiming a supply sink.

writers.classification: Publishes all four committed wallet denominations and revision, then GMCP; older revisions are ignored. This is a projection, not a second value event.

evidence: Native adapter harness checks committed wallet/revision publication and unresolved retention with controlled coordinator/world endpoints; no database execution.
writers.destination: Live wallet and GMCP projection; no second economic event

writers.classification: Builds a wallet endpoint before/after vector with checked denomination bounds and current revisions. No currency is mutated or submitted here.

evidence: Native adapter harness constructs wallet coin endpoints for controlled transfer completion scenarios; not all endpoint custody types.

writers.destination: Prepared endpoint before/after vectors; no mutation

writers.classification: Builds a coin transfer command, checks endpoint fences and wallet availability, retains callback context, and submits to the coordinator. Attached results attempt publication.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
evidence: Native adapter harness submits coin transfers and checks ambiguous/retry/malformed completion retention; no backend transaction.

writers.destination: Coordinator command, retained pending work and later publication

writers.classification: Generic and identified wallet/bank submission construct typed deltas and revisions, then retain pending callback context and submit. Rebasable bank rewards use the designated revision sentinel. Prepared submission returns true for an already pending ID without comparing the incoming payload at that shortcut.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
evidence: Native adapter harness covers prepared resubmission, pending operation identity and completion retention with a controlled coordinator.

writers.destination: Pending coordinator operation and callback; duplicate pending shortcut needs payload review

writers.classification: Converts a signed wallet value into denomination deltas and delegates to generic submission; no separate issuance or expense occurs in the adapter.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Denomination delta delegated to generic submission; no separate value event

writers.classification: Encodes a currency payload and assigns player/account keys and expected revisions under the supplied operation ID. The constructed command has no admission timestamp and does not mutate balances.

writers.destination: Encoded command and expected revisions; no balance change

writers.classification: Validates distinct source/destination identities and conserved copper value; checks wallet deltas and pile UID, payload and topology. Derives endpoint command IDs from the parent operation and endpoint index. Decode reconstructs the canonical command for comparison without applying it.

evidence: Native codec harness covers conservation, endpoint amounts, pile identity, malformed payloads and distinct child operation IDs; no database execution.

writers.destination: Canonical parent/child commands without economic mutation

writers.classification: Advances destination bank or custody revisions when shared with the executed source endpoint, rebuilding an item command while preserving its operation ID and admission timestamp. This adjusts a command plan rather than publishing a pile or wallet.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
evidence: Native helper tests cover shared-bank and shared-item-owner revision advancement, matching either source owner, mismatched initial revisions, immutable original request and retained child ID/timestamp. Repository transactions and full gameplay remain unqualified.

writers.destination: Adjusted expected revisions retaining operation identity and admission timestamp

writers.classification: Periodic depletion or the last reserved charge extracts the mine object; last-charge extraction precedes completion of the harvest event.

writers.classification: Zeros template cash on a newly allocated sage before room placement.

writers.classification: Materializes a configured nexus stone, assigns logical stone ID/alignment/timers/descriptions and places it in a room.

writers.classification: Wager calls SUB_MONEY then stores amount and denomination in the live table. Persisted-player SUB_MONEY success means asynchronous submission accepted, but this caller has no stake-commit callback before continuing the round.

writers.classification: After committed collection and runtime custody publication, promotes selected object contents to the original parent or room, then extracts only the selected live representation. Failed child relocation can stop partway through live publication.

writers.classification: Canonicalizes wallet after purchase price, updates player_data and increments wallet and bank revisions, then inserts currency ledger deltas. Bank denominations are unchanged; its revision update is not a bank expense. Legacy opening baselines are inserted if absent.

writers.classification: Generates an operation ID and submits typed collector work after bounded pending/listing/player checks. Identified and background entry points share the same helper; accepted pending work is not a completed transfer.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Typed collector intent and bounded pending/listing/player state

Completion publishes wallet/bank, custody and shop revision before invoking callback; pending entry is then erased. Covers buy, sell and cleanup payload variants, not an additional purchase at the adapter.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Typed trade intent and later committed result
writers.destination: Pending operation then wallet/custody/shop-revision publication and callback

writers.classification: Listing fees, bid debits and money-claim credits canonicalize the wallet and append legacy currency evidence. Bank revision advances with unchanged denominations. Existing winner pays only the bid increase; a new winner pays the full bid.

writers.classification: Revision-checked root item ownership moves between player and auction, with legacy ownership ledger evidence and both owner revisions advanced.

writers.destination: Auction or player root custody and ownership evidence

writers.classification: Creates listing and per-slot custody rows containing existing item UIDs, next revisions and captured blob.

writers.source: Existing seller root UIDs, revisions and serialized payload
writers.destination: Listing and per-slot auction custody records

writers.classification: Adds pending money and advances claim revision for displaced bidder refund or seller proceeds after closing fee.

writers.classification: Sets claim recipient on unclaimed custody slots for winner or returning seller.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; shared SQL harness candidate covers listing/bid/finalize/claim journey, not complete accounting qualification

writers.classification: Locks positive pending money, applies wallet credit and then zeroes matching claim value while advancing claim revision.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; shared SQL harness candidate covers listing/bid/finalize/claim journey, not complete accounting qualification
writers.destination: Actor wallet credit and zeroed claim with advanced revision

writers.classification: After matching claimant/revision checks and custody transition, marks each slot claimed with the original command ID and new item revision.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; shared SQL harness candidate covers listing/bid/finalize/claim journey, not complete accounting qualification
writers.source: Matching claimant custody slots and revisions
writers.destination: Player custody and consumed claim slots stamped with command identity

writers.classification: Decoder copies a length-checked object blob into a command payload, then validates payload and reconstructed command fences. The coin_bulk_mutation match is a buffer copy, not a coin write. The builder constructs and sorts actor/account, auction and item keys without applying economic state.

writers.classification: Actor and background wrappers share bounded pending admission and generate an operation ID. Completion publishes committed balance/custody; offline actor results wait in the pending map. Publication failure can report false and erase pending after durable commit.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; test candidate covers extracted publication/revision behavior, not full pending lifecycle
writers.source: Actor/background command intent and later committed result
writers.destination: Pending operation and live balance/custody projection; not independent issuance

writers.classification: Both listing callbacks detach and extract listed live roots after committed custody transfer, then mark player components dirty. Missing or moved roots log an alert and continue.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Live seller roots already transferred by durable commit
writers.destination: Runtime removal of those copies; auction custody retains economic ownership

writers.classification: Both claim callbacks deserialize the shared blob for each result item, overwrite UID with committed identity, attach to player and mark dirty. Deserialize failures alert and skip that child.
writers.authority_boundary: Restoration of an existing claimed holding, not new issuance. Exact per-item payload, repeated publication and durable save acknowledgement remain qualification gaps.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Committed claimant UIDs and shared serialized payload
writers.destination: Live player inventory copies using committed identities

writers.classification: Retained bid definition uses money helper debits/refunds around SQL bid history and previous bidder pickup staging; buy-now invokes current finalize wrapper. Symbol search finds definition only.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Bidder wallet and prior bid obligation
writers.destination: Legacy bid history, pending refund claim, or failure refund

writers.classification: Retained pickup decrements aggregate claim before separate wallet-credit submission; rejection callback or immediate failure attempts restoration. Item pickup materializes quantity, marks legacy row retrieved and attaches objects; failed load/claim disposes provisional object. Symbol search finds definition only.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Legacy aggregate money claim or serialized item pickup quantity
writers.destination: Wallet credit or live claimant inventory; failure restoration/cleanup

writers.classification: Retained finalize stages seller proceeds after closing fee and legacy item pickup rows, or seller return when no winner. Symbol search finds definition only.
writers.authority_boundary: Original escrow funds proceeds and fee; staging claim is not issuance. Retained definition is not proof of active settlement coverage.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Legacy winning bid and listed item payload
writers.destination: Seller proceeds after fee and winner item pickup, or unsold seller return

writers.classification: Backfill, resort and info deserialize temporary objects to compute metadata or display identification, then extract them. Backfill is retained tooling; resort/info are command paths.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Serialized auction payload read for metadata/display
writers.destination: Temporary decoded object, then cleanup; no gameplay admission

writers.classification: Persisted PCs route put and PC give to compound coin commands. Remaining drop/give submits wallet_spend then callback publishes or compensates; nonpersisted/NPC actor uses SUB_MONEY and synchronous callback.
writers.authority_boundary: Dispatch semantics differ by actor and destination. Wallet debit acceptance alone is not completed transfer; retain original identity and actual transient holding policy.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; candidate checks source routing/order, not native end-to-end settlement
writers.source: Actor wallet and requested put/give/drop context
writers.destination: Compound transfer or legacy debit followed by publication/compensation

writers.classification: Merges denominations into an existing transient pile via add_coins or creates a provisional pile, temporarily attaches to actor, and invokes put. Failed put extracts the provisional object. PC-corpse wrapper subsequently calls writeCorpse.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Existing transient pile or new provisional pile passed through put; rejected provisional copy discarded

writers.classification: Builds before/after denomination and custody snapshot for pile creation, change or consumption. add_coins renders descriptions on a temporary object; item command construction does not mutate the live pile.
writers.authority_boundary: New/consumed pile shell lifetime and transferred money are distinct linked facts. Temporary rendering is not issuance or a live balance change.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; candidate has structural staging/cleanup checks; full runtime failure qualification remains separate
writers.source: Existing or proposed pile value, identity and custody
writers.destination: Before/after endpoint and serialized pile description; no live mutation

writers.classification: Revision-checked committed pile publication removes consumed piles, discards detached copies for offline owners, or restores exact UID and attaches it to its container. Newer revisions suppress stale publication; live denomination copy and description update project the committed result.
writers.authority_boundary: Consumption is linked to transferred value, while offline detached cleanup is not economic destruction. Hydration/materialization must not be counted again as issuance; save and restart qualification remain separate.

writers.destination: Live coin-pile value[0..3], copied at actobj.c:4001; projection of existing committed value, not issuance.

writers.classification: Rejected coin put completion extracts a newly created still-detached pile; successful result instead publishes the committed destination endpoint.
writers.authority_boundary: Cleanup of a never-admitted candidate, not value destruction. Failed committed publication remains unresolved rather than permission to refund or reissue blindly.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified; candidate has structural staging/cleanup checks; full runtime failure qualification remains separate
writers.source: New detached pile associated with rejected put
writers.destination: Discarded provisional object; committed result uses endpoint publication

writers.classification: Missing runtime custody triggers an absent-item movement with the same source/destination. Admission callback rechecks UID, container, outer location and owner before continuing pickup. Failed continuation leaves the admitted pile available and does not credit a wallet.
writers.authority_boundary: Existing pile admission is separate from pickup; absence from runtime registry does not prove fresh economic issuance. Preserve source provenance and original lifetime; admission replay must not mint coins.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Existing pile with missing runtime custody
writers.destination: Same-owner admitted custody, then revalidated pickup continuation

writers.classification: PC money pickup returns through submit_coin_get. Remaining NPC branch clears pile denomination values, computes int copper total, calls ADD_MONEY and detaches/extracts the pile. Retained notall display/description branch is guarded by a local initialized to zero and never assigned again in this function.
writers.authority_boundary: NPC pile-to-live-wallet transfer needs explicit holding/lifetime policy; do not model extraction as independent sink. Arithmetic/refusal outcomes and scanner-missed value[] writes must be reviewed; no durable NPC wallet is proven here.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Existing pile denomination values consumed by legacy NPC pickup.
writers.destination: NPC wallet through ADD_MONEY; source pile cleared and retired. Legacy arithmetic and persistence remain unqualified.

writers.classification: PC durable pickup submits source-to-player movement using locker/corpse/get reason. Tracked NPC pickup submits a same-owner mobile_claim boundary before live handoff, leaving room/corpse authority rather than inventing persistent NPC inventory.
writers.authority_boundary: Preserve exact source, selected subtree, claimant and actual authority policy; a live handoff or mobile_claim is not evidence of new durable NPC ownership.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: PC custody or same-owner NPC mobile-claim boundary before live handoff

writers.classification: Condition-zero pickup invokes MakeScrap and returns before normal item/coin transfer submission.
writers.authority_boundary: Source retirement and any scrap helper output need linked input/output identities; failed pickup is not automatically no economic change.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Scrap transformation before ordinary pickup transfer

writers.classification: Only alive trusted characters pass entry guard. Junk rejects artifacts; ordinary item destruction rewards ten copper, while visible nontransient bulk items invoke an additional ten-copper ADD_MONEY before destruction. Transient items dissolve without reward.
writers.authority_boundary: Preserve current bulk/single/visibility economics explicitly, including two reward calls for visible bulk items. Link retired item/container subtree to reward children; asynchronous reward acceptance is not durable completion and must not silently change reward policy.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Item destruction and ordinary/bulk copper reward; transient dissolution has no reward

writers.classification: Detach an existing item from its container and attach it to the character; adjust container space and announce movement. This helper serves live publication rather than new issuance.
writers.authority_boundary: Acknowledged corpse bulk haul re-finds the UID after insertion and rejects failed carriage. The helper alone does not establish commit, recovery or native save acknowledgement.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Character inventory and updated container space; live transfer projection

writers.classification: Resolved player drop submits existing-item custody; completion checks committed context and live source before detaching and placing the item in the recorded room.
writers.authority_boundary: Redis floor hint, dirty components and corpse write invocation are projections/persistence requests, not proof of acknowledged saving. Stale completion alerts without completing live handoff.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Committed player item drop and verified live source
writers.destination: Recorded room custody/live placement

writers.classification: Committed player gift callback moves an existing live item to the recipient PID, marks both players dirty and invokes give hooks. Missing recipient or changed source alerts and returns.
writers.authority_boundary: Committed custody precedes live handoff. Callback checks source carriage but does not recheck shared room; hooks may cause subsequent outcomes. Dirty marks do not establish save acknowledgement or atomic hook execution.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Committed player gift and sender live item
writers.destination: Recipient PID inventory, dirty state and give hooks

writers.classification: Committed owner/pet gift verifies runtime pet, durable pet identity, master/charm, owner PID, original room and source carriage. Success moves the live item and invokes hooks; stale topology extracts an extant live copy and requests reconnect recovery.
writers.authority_boundary: Stale-copy extraction retires a representation after committed custody, not economic destruction. Owner/pet dirty marks and reconnect advice are not native save or restart-recovery qualification.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.source: Committed owner/pet gift with verified identity/topology
writers.destination: Pet live inventory; stale copy cleanup requests reconnect recovery

writers.classification: Existing item is detached from room and inserted into character after the command admission/acknowledgement branches; no-loot checks are bypassed during acknowledgement publication.
writers.authority_boundary: Floor hint removal, dirty marking, lighting and corpse write calls do not independently prove durable ownership or acknowledged saving.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
writers.destination: Character inventory live projection

writers.symbol:
static void continue_bulk_get(P_char actor, uint32_t actor_pid)
{
writers.classification: Bulk pickup first admits missing roots one at a time to the same source owner, then submits the complete durable forest to the player. Known roots with mismatching ownership are refused.
writers.authority_boundary: Source availability and each selected root are rechecked between adoption callbacks. Earlier source admissions can remain committed if the final pickup fails; they are not player delivery or proof of fresh issuance. Durable forest publication and deferred coin pickups are distinct operations.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
